ruling: - **R60. An option keeps its letter and carries an id.** Read: at 14:39 CST Nov 12 triage reordered item 646 after the chat question went out, so chat a became page b. The owner's "a" (15:03 CST) could have been filed as the opposite pick. Owner 15:07 CST: "in general if sessions create options triage should hold those letters the same (or they shd be referenced by IDs each option rather than A B which can be arbitrarily swapped)". 1. Triage keeps each option's letter as the asking session wrote it; a rule-driven change adds a note to the option and reorders nothing. 2. Each option carries a short id, and a stored pick records that id, not the letter. 3. An answer to an item whose letters moved after it was shown is held, and the owner confirms in words. Step: option-keys-match-chat (#2682).
